summary: Comprehensive testing of AI Tutor feature for SCORM courses. Backend (10/10 tests passed): GET/PUT tutor-settings, POST tutor/chat with Gemini integration, message limit enforcement, error handling. Frontend (all components verified): Admin panel Tutor IA tab loads correctly with all form controls, settings save and persist on reload. SCORM export includes tutor.js, tutor.css, and tutorConfig in course.json when enabled.
passed_tests: ✅ GET /api/admin/tutor-settings returns default settings with correct structure
✅ PUT /api/admin/tutor-settings saves settings to MongoDB and verifies persistence
✅ POST /api/tutor/chat returns 400 when message is empty
✅ POST /api/tutor/chat sends message and gets AI response from Gemini (via Emergent LLM Key)
✅ POST /api/tutor/chat respects message limit (returns limitReached=true when exceeded)
✅ POST /api/tutor/chat uses conversation history for context-aware responses
✅ POST /api/tutor/chat returns 403 when tutor is disabled
✅ SCORM export includes tutor.js, tutor.css, and tutorConfig when tutor enabled
✅ SCORM export excludes tutorConfig when tutor disabled
✅ Frontend: Admin panel Tutor IA tab loads with all components
✅ Frontend: Enable/disable toggle visible and functional
✅ Frontend: Tutor name input works and persists
✅ Frontend: Message limit input works and persists
✅ Frontend: Suggested questions can be added and removed
✅ Frontend: Save button triggers API call and shows success toast
✅ Frontend: Settings persist after page reload
